On Thu, Aug 5, 2026 at 10:05 AM vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai wrote:
> Proposed timeline: draft invoice + line items by EOD Aug 6, DocuSign envelope same day if PO is available.

Thanks Vanessa and Marta — I ran the numbers with the standard committed rate in your existing contract (model: rwd-large-v2, effective seat-rate equivalent). Calculation summary:
- Extra generation tokens: 320,000 tokens
- Contracted overage rate (per 1k tokens): $7.00
- Gross true-up = (320,000 / 1,000) * $7.00 = $2,240.00
- Proposed goodwill credit: 20% = $448.00
- Net one-time invoice = $1,792.00

If SpringSys prefers a smaller goodwill credit (10%) or no credit, we can adjust. We can also split the amount across two invoices if AP needs it. Laura, please generate the invoice #8742 with net amount $1,792.00 and include line items that reference the token delta window (2026-06-04—2026-06-18) and HubSpot deal RDW-DEAL-8742.

Marta — does that net number look acceptable for a single settlement? Once you confirm, we will issue the DocuSign envelope and attach the PDF.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
